Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic Cross-linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS) study to determine the 3D structure of protein complexes. While the biological context involves ubiquitination, the proteomics assay itself is not an enrichment for ubiquitin remnants (diGly), but rather a structural analysis using chemical crosslinkers (DTSSP, DSSO).

scope: We generated complexes between the chaperones (Hsp70 or Hsp90), the cochaperone CHIP and, as substrate, a p53 variant containing the GST protein (p53-TMGST).
The crosslinked complex was trypsin-digested and the resulting peptides analysed by liquid chromatography coupled to tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS).
Purified DTSSP-crosslinked complexes were precipitated using the methanol/chloroform method, and the protein pellet was dissolved in 10 µL 8 M urea, 25 mM NH4HCO3.
The sample was loaded onto a Ni-NTA agarose column (HisTrap FF 5 mL, GE Healthcare) using an AKTA prime FPLC (GE Healthcare).
Fractions with the highest purity and correct oligomerization state were pooled and concentrated to 1 mL using an Amicon Ultra 15.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material consisted of recombinant protein complexes (Hsp70/Hsp90, CHIP, and p53-TMGST) purified via Ni-NTA affinity chromatography and gel filtration, then crosslinked and analyzed by LC-MS/MS.
